sections.heading: Frames Devnet 0 Status
sections.summary: Frames devnet 0 is running cleanly with roughly 10 frame-type transactions per block from a spamoor instance.
sections.body:
- Frames devnet 0 is live and healthy; [Dora explorer](https://dora.frames-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io) looks "100%" to EthPandaOps, with no issues raised.
- A [spamoor instance](https://spamoor.frames-devnet-0.ethpandaops.io) is sending roughly 10 frame-type transactions per block.
- No issues reported by any client team; no news is good news.
- Agreement to let devnet 0 continue running while the scope of devnet 1 is determined.

sections.heading: Frames Devnet 1 Scope and Timeline
sections.summary: Devnet 1 will add EIPs 8250, 8272, and 7906, targeting launch next Thursday with test releases Monday.
sections.body:
- No objections to moving forward with 3 clients (Geth, Nethermind, ethrex) rather than waiting for more client implementations.
  - Lightclient: "I think we are good to keep pushing with geth, nethermind, and ethrex."
- [EIP-8250](https://forkcast.org/eips/8250/?tab=spec) (keyed nonces) and [EIP-8272](https://forkcast.org/eips/8272/?tab=spec) (recent roots) confirmed for devnet 1 with no objections.
- [EIP-7906](https://forkcast.org/eips/7906/?tab=spec) also added after Nethermind confirmed it is already implemented; Geth (lightclient) said implementation is not a concern.
- EIPs 8253 and 7979 (proposed by Spencer) deferred to a future devnet to keep frames devnet 1 simple.
- Timeline: test releases targeting Monday, client images by Tuesday, devnet launch aiming for Thursday next week.
- Barnabas proposed a cadence of a new devnet every two weeks going forward.
- Two additional spec changes to EIP-8141 proposed by lightclient for devnet 1:
  - Deploy expiry verifier via Nick's method instead of adding it to state at the fork block ([PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12387)): no objections, will be merged after the call.
  - Bound cost with `max_fee` ([PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12414)): deferred to devnet 2 or later because Nethermind and ethrex have not yet reviewed the proposal; lightclient described it as a conceptually big change that needs more time.

sections.heading: EIP-8250 Keyed Nonces Design Concerns
sections.summary: Lightclient raised concerns that EIP-8250's system-contract approach is hacky but accepted it as the best option before PBT.
sections.body:
- Lightclient expressed dissatisfaction with EIP-8250's use of a precompile/system contract to store user nonce state, calling it a "hacky" solution that conflates user state storage with protocol-level transaction uniqueness invariants.
  - Concern about future migration complexity when the tree structure changes.
- Soispoke responded that a migration to PBT has been discussed with Carlos and Maria and is feasible; the amount of data to migrate would likely be small.
- Lightclient acknowledged the alternative is to wait for PBT and forgo private transactions in Hegota, which is not a desirable tradeoff.
- No objections raised by other participants; consensus to move forward with 8250 despite the design reservations.
  - Lightclient: "I'm not gonna block it… this is something I'm not a fan of."

sections.heading: Verification Prefix Gas Limit for Devnet 1
sections.summary: Agreement to raise the verification prefix gas limit to 500K for devnet 1 to enable more realistic testing of complex frame transactions.
sections.body:
- Daniil (Nethermind) asked about changing the verification prefix limit for the next devnet to test more complex scenarios with keyed nonces and recent roots.
- Soispoke supported a higher limit for testing purposes, noting it helps with real wallet/app workflow feedback when sending private transactions; emphasized it need not be a commitment to a permanent higher limit.
- Daniil suggested at least 300K; Mo Jahanara noted 250K is enough for privacy protocols but tight.
- Agreement: 500K for devnet 1, with no objections from any participant.
- Nethermind also reported partial implementation of [Matcha](https://ethresear.ch/t/mempool-account-transaction-capacity-from-historical-activity-matcha/25949) (mempool account transaction capacity) already merged, expecting full implementation by the next call or devnet.

sections.heading: ETH Magicians Feedback and Frame Transaction Simulation
sections.summary: A proposal to relax halting behavior for transaction param 0 was flagged for review; frame transaction simulation via JSON-RPC remains unresolved.
sections.body:
- pdobacz posted in the [ETH Magicians thread for EIP-8141](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8141-frame-transaction/27617/174) suggesting that the halting behavior for transaction param 0 in non-frame contexts should be relaxed.
  - No immediate opinions formed on the call; left for async review.
- Frame transaction simulation via JSON-RPC, raised by jxom (viem author) on the previous call, had no new opinions or decisions.
  - Topic deferred to the next call.
- Reminder: 13 open PRs against the frames spec remain; teams encouraged to address any that are blocking devnet 1.
  - [Forkcast link for EIP-8141 history](https://forkcast.org/eips/8141/?tab=history)

sections.heading: FOCIL and Frames Devnet Merge Strategy
sections.summary: Separate FOCIL and frames devnets will merge into Hegota devnet 0 targeting end of October; scoping discussion to continue Thursday.
sections.body:
- Original goal was to merge FOCIL and frames devnets before Devcon.
- Spencer outlined the expected progression: frames devnet 1 → Hegota devnet 0 (merged FOCIL devnet 1 + frames devnet 1) → only Hegota devnets going forward.
  - Barnabas confirmed: once the merged Hegota devnet exists, separate FOCIL and frames devnets will be discontinued.
- Lightclient noted he has not looked deeply into the FOCIL integration; readiness depends on how far along FOCIL is.
- Marc has started spec work for the integration but is waiting on feedback from the ethrex team to align on details; implementation expected to be modest in size.
- Soispoke noted Nethermind and ethrex have made significant progress but need alignment on specific implementation details; Geth alignment also needed.
- Mario Vega (testing team) recommended getting frames and FOCIL interacting as soon as possible to test mempool behavior.
- Barnabas suggested Hegota devnet 0 could target October 28th.
  - Would require scoping FOCIL devnet 2 to match that timeline.
  - Proposed adding the merge-timing decision to this Thursday's ACDE agenda; committed to doing so.
- Spencer expressed optimism that Hegota could be one of the fastest post-merge forks, potentially under 7 months after Glamsterdam mainnet.
- Next FOCIL breakout is scheduled for next Tuesday, but Barnabas flagged that may be too late if they want to launch a week after; offline scoping discussions encouraged.

sections.heading: Flexible Verification Floor Proposal
sections.summary: Daniil proposed redefining max verification gas as a floor rather than a hard limit; lightclient pushed back on network stress without a peer communication mechanism.
sections.body:
- Daniil (Nethermind) proposed redefining `const max_verify_gas` as a shared mempool floor rather than a hard limit ([PR](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12301)).
  - Nodes meeting the floor would be guaranteed to gossip transactions under that limit; nodes with higher capacity could optionally process heavier verification prefixes.
  - Transactions above the floor would have fewer nodes able to gossip them, propagating more slowly.
- Lightclient objected: sending transactions to peers who cannot verify them adds stress to the network and complicates mempool optimization.
  - Without a protocol-level mechanism for peers to communicate their verification limit, nodes cannot know which transactions peers can accept.
  - Analogy to storage history communication in existing protocols.
- No resolution; Daniil acknowledged the feedback. Topic left for async discussion.
